project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite SPA, RTL Arabic EdTech platform
build_system: Vite 5.4, tsc for typecheck. No Tailwind - custom CSS design system with token layer.
test_framework: None configured (no test runner in package.json)
build_command: Cannot run - node_modules not installed and INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode
verification_instructions: Verify CSS syntax correctness manually. Ensure no CSS parse errors, check that all var() references resolve to tokens defined in tokens.css. Validate no conflicting selectors are introduced.
setup_instructions: Cannot install dependencies (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY). Work directly with source CSS files.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no npm install, no external fetches. node_modules not present. Validation is AST/syntax-level only. Cannot run tsc or vite build.
contribution_requirements: Keep current design direction. Do not add new features. Do not break existing functionality. RTL (dir=rtl) awareness required.
key_patterns: CSS loaded in specific order via main.tsx imports (tokens -> stitch-tokens -> base -> components -> utilities -> landing -> premium -> system -> responsive -> dashboard -> interactions -> notifications -> polish -> landing-auth-v3 -> stitch-canonical -> redesign-landing -> redesign-dashboard -> redesign-lecture -> redesign-matrix -> redesign-global -> pdf -> owner). Later files override earlier ones. Design tokens in tokens.css use CSS custom properties with 8px grid spacing (--sp-N), Material 3 color system, typography scale (--fs-xxs through --fs-4xl), motion tokens. Dark theme is default (:root + [data-theme=dark]), light theme via [data-theme=light]. Stitch-canonical.css uses !important to enforce final design decisions. Polish.css adds page header hero treatment. Responsive.css has universal overflow protection.
directory_structure: frontend/src/styles/ - 22 CSS files forming layered design system. frontend/src/pages/ - page components (LandingPage, AuthPage, DocumentViewerPage, plus role directories). frontend/src/components/ - shared components (BrandMark, Icon, layout/, primitives/, owner/, pdf/).
